initialExam.title: MAHA TET 2026 (Maharashtra TET)
initialExam.description: Maharashtra Teacher Eligibility Test for aspiring teachers in Maharashtra state government and aided schools. June 2026 session notification released.
initialExam.eligibility: Paper I: D.El.Ed/B.El.Ed or Graduation with 50% + B.Ed. Paper II: Graduation with 50% + B.Ed.
initialExam.vacancies: Eligibility test — leads to teaching posts
initialExam.syllabus: Paper I (Class I-V): Child Development & Pedagogy (30Q), Language I Marathi (30Q), Language II English (30Q), Mathematics (30Q), Environmental Studies (30Q). Paper II (Class VI-VIII): CDP (30Q), Lang I (30Q), Lang II (30Q), Maths/Science or Social Science (60Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I: 150 MCQs, 150 marks, 2.5 hours. Paper II: 150 MCQs, 150 marks, 2.5 hours. Paper I: 10:30 AM - 1 PM. Paper II: 2:30 - 5 PM.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Qualify MAHA TET (60% for General, 55% for OBC/SC/ST) → Apply for state teaching recruitment → Merit-based selection
initialExam.jobRole: Primary Teacher (Class I-V) and Upper Primary Teacher (Class VI-VIII) in Maharashtra government/aided schools
initialExam.careerGrowth: Primary Teacher → Headmaster → Education Officer → District Education Officer.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit mahatet.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload photo and signature 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, Summer/Winter vacations, LTC

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
